name: Peanutsquare
description: Peanut Square is an Odoo-focused ERP and software services company that helps businesses automate operations and scale. Based in Ahmedabad and serving clients worldwide, they provide end-to-end Odoo consulting, implementation, customization, development, migration, and support, alongside web, mobile, and SaaS development. Their solutions cover CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, manufacturing, HR/payroll, and eCommerce, integrating third-party tools for secure, scalable digital transformation.

events.d: Create a CRM lead and set contact info, assignment, source and tags, address, and notes.
Update an existing lead's information in the CRM.

events.n: When a new lead is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new lead is created in the account.
Polls Peanutsquare (Odoo) for new contacts created within the last scheduled interval.
Retrieve contacts (res.partner) from Odoo and return basic fields (id, name, email, phone, mobile, street, city). Supports an optional result limit.
List salespeople in your Odoo instance.
List sales teams from your Odoo CRM.
Retrieve UTM source records (utm.source) from your Odoo instance.
Find tags used for partners/contacts, with optional filters for name, parent, top-level only, and pagination (limit/offset).
Create a contact (company or person) and add details like name, contact info, address, business attributes (VAT, customer/supplier), tags, parent company, and assigned user.
Find contacts by name, email, phone, company, location, or category and return selected fields with pagination and sorting.

Update a contact in Odoo by Contact ID or email. Change selected fields (name, company, job title, email, phone, address, tags, salesperson, active status). Empty values are skipped and the action returns the updated…
Archive a contact or restore it to active status.
Cancel a sales order and optionally add a cancellation note.
Create a CRM opportunity (lead) with customer, expected revenue, stage, contact details, deadline, assignment, source/tags, address, and notes.

Search leads or opportunities using filters (ID, name, partner, owner, team, stage, tags, revenue, active status, creation or deadline dates). Choose fields to return, sort results, and set limit and offset.
Mark an opportunity in Odoo as Won.
Create a sales quotation for a customer, including order lines (products, quantities, prices, discounts), addresses, payment terms, and assignment details.
Search sales orders by ID, customer, salesperson, state, date range, or amount. Optionally include order line details.

events.n: Add Product Line To Sales Order
events.d: Add a product line with quantity, unit price, and discount to an existing sales order.
Confirm a quotation to convert it into a sales order.
Create a new product in Odoo with sales and cost prices, category and unit settings, SKU/barcode, and other identification details.
Search for products by ID, name, SKU (default code), barcode, category, active status, or low stock. Returns selected fields and available quantity.
Change a product's sales price and/or cost price.
Create a customer invoice with line items, taxes, dates, and journal and currency settings.
Finalize a draft invoice and mark it as posted for accounting. Requires at least one invoice line and that the invoice is not cancelled.
Retrieve posted customer invoices with outstanding balances. Filter by customer, date range, minimum amount due, and overdue-only.

events.n: When an order is created or confirmed
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever an order is created or whenever an existing order is confirmed.

events.n: When a new product is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new product is added in the account.

events.n: When a new payment is received
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new incoming payment is recorded in the account.

events.n: When a tag is added to a contact
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a tag is added to a contact ,  whether the contact is newly created with that tag or an existing contact receives a new tag. The workflow runs once for each tag assignment.
Create a tag to organize contacts or records, with optional color and parent tag. If a tag with the same name exists, return that tag instead of creating a duplicate.
Find contacts that have the selected tag(s), with optional filters and result limits.
Add one or more tags to a customer without removing any existing tags.
